rules.name: Requirements Overview
rules.desc:
All coursework toward the PhD Minor must be at the 200 level or above. Units taken toward the Minor may be counted toward the overall PhD residency requirement of 135 units. Units counted toward the PhD Minor may not be used toward fulfilling another PhD Minor or a Master’s degree.
PhD Minors must complete at least 20 units of CSRE coursework. Students must fulfill the following coursework requirements:

rules.name: Theory
rules.notes: Note that CSRE 300 must be taken for 5 units and letter grade if taken to fulfill the requirements of the PhD Minor.

rules.name: Workshop
rules.notes: The PhD Minor workshop series focuses on anti-racist pedagogy, community engagement, and professional development. Although the workshop may be listed for a range of units, only one unit per workshop quarter may be counted toward the PhD Minor.

rules.name: Additional Theory Course
rules.notes: These courses fulfill the additional theory requirement of the PhD Minor. Note that this is not a complete list and may not reflect coursework that is offered in the current academic year. For a complete list of PhD Minor Theory courses that are offered in the current academic year, consult the coursework page on the CSRE PhD Minor website.

rules.name: Elective Graduate-Level Courses
rules.desc:
Complete at least two additional electives to meet the overall 20-unit minimum.
PhD Minors take at least two additional graduate-level courses focused on race and ethnicity, or as many electives as necessary to meet the 20-unit minimum to complete the PhD Minor. One of these electives must be housed outside the student's home department. Additional courses may be approved as electives but must be submitted to the CCSRE Academic Programs team for pre-approval no later than the first week of the quarter in which the course is offered.
rules.notes: Note that this is not a complete list and may not reflect coursework that is offered in the current academic year. For a complete list of approved elective courses that are offered in the current academic year, consult the coursework page on the CSRE PhD Minor website.

rules.name: One elective housed outside the student's home department

transferPolicy: Per policy (GAP 4.5.1 Doctoral Degrees, Requirements), all of the coursework for a Ph.D. minor must be completed at Stanford.
reviewNotes: The audit checks the 20 units of the PhD minor: CSRE 300 for 5 units and a letter grade, the three CSRE 301 workshop quarters (one unit each counts), one additional theory course and at least two graduate electives from the listed courses. You check by hand that one elective is housed outside your home department, electives the CCSRE Academic Programs team pre-approves, and that these units are not also used for another PhD minor or a master's degree.
